{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module FileService where

import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as C8
import Data.IORef
import System.IO
import Control.Monad (when, unless, forM_)
import Data.List (isPrefixOf, isInfixOf)
import System.Directory (doesFileExist, getFileSize)
import Data.Word (Word64)

-- Role hierarchy: Admin > Editor > Viewer
data Role = Viewer | Editor | Admin deriving (Eq, Ord, Show)

data User = User
  { userName :: String
  , userRole :: Role
  } deriving (Show)

data FileChunk = FileChunk
  { chunkData :: BS.ByteString
  , chunkOffset :: Word64
  , chunkSize :: Word64
  } deriving (Show)

-- Configuration for recursive file processing
data ProcessConfig = ProcessConfig
  { maxRecursionDepth :: Int
  , maxFrameSize :: Word64
  , stackBudget :: Word64
  , allowNestedIncludes :: Bool
  } deriving (Show)

defaultConfig :: ProcessConfig
defaultConfig = ProcessConfig
  { maxRecursionDepth = 64
  , maxFrameSize = 4096
  , stackBudget = 1048576  -- 1MB stack budget
  , allowNestedIncludes = True
  }

-- Access control check
canAccess :: User -> FilePath -> IO Bool
canAccess user path = do
  exists <- doesFileExist path
  if not exists
    then return False
    else case userRole user of
      Admin  -> return True
      Editor -> return $ not ("/etc/" `isPrefixOf` path || "/root/" `isPrefixOf` path)
      Viewer -> return $ "/public/" `isPrefixOf` path || "/shared/" `isPrefixOf` path

-- Compute per-frame allocation based on content
computeFrameAllocation :: BS.ByteString -> ProcessConfig -> Word64
computeFrameAllocation content cfg =
  let baseSize = fromIntegral (BS.length content)
      -- Each include directive adds to frame cost
      includeCount = countIncludes content
      frameCost = baseSize + (fromIntegral includeCount * maxFrameSize cfg)
  in frameCost

countIncludes :: BS.ByteString -> Int
countIncludes bs =
  let lines' = C8.lines bs
      isInclude l = "#include " `C8.isPrefixOf` l
  in length (filter isInclude lines')

-- Stack budget tracking - checks BEFORE consuming but uses
-- unchecked arithmetic for the actual consumption
data StackState = StackState
  { currentDepth :: IORef Int
  , consumedStack :: IORef Word64
  }

newStackState :: IO StackState
newStackState = do
  d <- newIORef 0
  s <- newIORef 0
  return $ StackState d s

-- The vulnerability: checkAndConsume checks budget with the BASE content size
-- but the recursive processFileInner adds frameCost which includes
-- include-amplified size. The check uses 'contentSize' but consumption
-- uses 'frameCost' which can be much larger due to include counting.
checkAndConsume :: StackState -> ProcessConfig -> Word64 -> Word64 -> IO Bool
checkAndConsume state cfg contentSize frameCost = do
  consumed <- readIORef (consumedStack state)
  depth <- readIORef (currentDepth state)
  -- Guard: check against contentSize (the raw file size)
  if consumed + contentSize > stackBudget cfg
    then return False
    else if depth >= maxRecursionDepth cfg
      then return False
      else do
        -- But consume the full frameCost (which includes include amplification)
        writeIORef (consumedStack state) (consumed + frameCost)
        modifyIORef' (currentDepth state) (+1)
        return True

releaseFrame :: StackState -> Word64 -> IO ()
releaseFrame state frameCost = do
  consumed <- readIORef (consumedStack state)
  -- Underflow-safe subtraction
  let newConsumed = if consumed >= frameCost then consumed - frameCost else 0
  writeIORef (consumedStack state) newConsumed
  modifyIORef' (currentDepth state) (subtract 1)

-- Process a file with recursive include resolution
processFileInner :: User -> FilePath -> ProcessConfig -> StackState -> IO (Either String [FileChunk])
processFileInner user path cfg state = do
  allowed <- canAccess user path
  unless allowed $ error "Access denied"
  
  content <- BS.readFile path
  let contentSize = fromIntegral (BS.length content)
  let frameCost = computeFrameAllocation content cfg
  
  -- Check uses contentSize, consume uses frameCost
  ok <- checkAndConsume state cfg contentSize frameCost
  if not ok
    then return $ Left "Stack budget exceeded"
    else do
      result <- processContent user content path cfg state
      releaseFrame state frameCost
      return result

processContent :: User -> BS.ByteString -> FilePath -> ProcessConfig -> StackState -> IO (Either String [FileChunk])
processContent user content basePath cfg state = do
  let lines' = C8.lines content
  chunks <- newIORef []
  offset <- newIORef (0 :: Word64)
  
  forM_ lines' $ \line -> do
    if "#include " `C8.isPrefixOf` line && allowNestedIncludes cfg
      then do
        let includePath = C8.unpack (C8.drop 9 line)
        subResult <- processFileInner user includePath cfg state
        case subResult of
          Left err -> return ()  -- Skip failed includes silently
          Right subChunks -> modifyIORef' chunks (++ subChunks)
      else do
        curOffset <- readIORef offset
        let chunk = FileChunk
              { chunkData = line
              , chunkOffset = curOffset
              , chunkSize = fromIntegral (BS.length line)
              }
        modifyIORef' chunks (++ [chunk])
        modifyIORef' offset (+ fromIntegral (BS.length line) + 1)
  
  readIORef chunks >>= \cs -> return (Right cs)

-- Public API
processFile :: User -> FilePath -> IO (Either String [FileChunk])
processFile user path = do
  state <- newStackState
  processFileInner user path defaultConfig state

-- Entry point for batch processing
processBatch :: User -> [FilePath] -> IO [(FilePath, Either String [FileChunk])]
processBatch user paths = do
  state <- newStackState
  mapM (\p -> do
    result <- processFileInner user p defaultConfig state
    return (p, result)
    ) paths
